intent: Preserve independent semantic observations on every saved target output, separately from machine grades and final acceptance.
reviewer: contextual_review; did not author prompt candidates, cases or target outputs
manifest_method: SHA256 of JSON.stringify(sorted filename and raw-file-SHA256 pairs under raw/targets).

findings.observation: A clean advance to an unmet recognition task occurs in baseline1/3, candidate1/3 and task_meaning2/3. Task_meaning r3 still requires the learner to say the plausibility question out loud, an additional exercise not required by the configured task.
findings.counterevidence: Task_meaning r1 and r2 move to persuasive wording. They show that the model can recognize the short contextual answer as sufficient under this prompt, although reliability is incomplete.

findings.observation: Task_meaning r1 and r2 correctly move to observing whether the source is established; r3 asks an additional generic action after the completed plausibility judgment. Baseline asks that additional action3/3. Candidate r2/r3 do the same; candidate r1 begins source-verification behavior before establishing its source-observation meaning.
findings.implication: The general conflict-removal refinement helps a second scenario as well as the motivating gift-card case, but retains a failure in each.

findings.observation: All three task_meaning replies ask why future plans are risky. Candidate replies similarly retest timing/location meaning3/3. Baseline r1 stops at praise despite a remaining posting-time behavior; r2/r3 retest future exposure. None clearly elicits the distinct still-unfinished posting-time behavior.
findings.basis: The learner already connects the cafe/time to strangers finding Mira in the tomorrow context and supplies private coordination. The reference explicitly forbids a mandatory extra demonstration of that same future exposure.

findings.observation: That seems too high supplies the required plausibility judgment after only Okay, before a relevant learner attempt or confusion. This is a clear component-disclosure failure despite staying on the correct task.
findings.counterevidence: Task_meaning r1/r3 leave a plausibility judgment for the learner, as do all three first-candidate replies.

findings.observation: All arms preserve the still-unfinished behavior by asking for a specific action rather than treating Not safe as an action answer. Candidate r1/r2 additionally prescribe the privacy goal; apply the inherited disclosure boundary consistently rather than equating useful progression with all-metric success.

Task_meaning3/3 retains earlier completion despite Okay and asks about the next unwanted-contact observation. Candidate r2 gives unwanted messages/calls as its own answer cue. Baseline r3 moves to how to respond to private-information requests before the new unwanted-contact observation is learner-established.

Candidate and task_meaning3/3 recognize the short answer and ask the distinct checking behavior. Baseline r1 asks whether the shortened suffix matches the club name, repeating already-established hidden-destination recognition while suggesting an unreliable check; baseline r2/r3 ask the corresponding behavior.
Every arm consolidates3/3 without inventing another task. This is useful counterevidence to a claim that either prompt invariably repeats completed work.
findings.scope_limit: Several replies call the offer fake or claim broad future safety. Those accuracy/generalization claims exceed the narrow completion checks and are not silently added as new acceptance criteria.

findings.observation: All arms explicitly correct the contradicted public-visibility claim3/3. Task_meaning r2 then promises the next safety check, but does not actually ask or teach another task; this is ambiguous future progression intent, not counted here as a confident premature-transition failure. Task_meaning r3 says Only private messages stay hidden, an overbroad factual claim retained as an adjacent finding rather than silently expanding this focused metric scope.

interpretation: Task-specific completion is a useful general specification and the task_meaning intervention improves two exposed plausibility scenarios, but overlapping-task repetition and premature disclosure remain. No candidate passes every declared completion boundary. These are focused diagnostic observations, not a fully independently relabeled aggregate dataset or evidence of human learning effects.
machine_grade_review: Pending completion of uniform V2 judging; known disagreements will be preserved separately without overwriting model grades.
